title: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
summary: India Code's Act includes provisions concerning a woman's residence in a shared household and possible protection, residence, monetary, custody, compensation, and interim orders. These are court-related provisions, not automatic outcomes; a qualified local advisor can explain how they may apply.

content.en: India Code's Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 includes a right to reside in a shared household (section 17) and provisions under which a Magistrate may consider protection, residence, monetary, custody, compensation, and interim or ex parte orders (sections 18–23). This is general information about the Act; an order is not automatic and how it applies depends on the facts and the proper authority.
content.hi: India Code के Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 में साझा घर में रहने के अधिकार (धारा 17) और वे प्रावधान शामिल हैं जिनके तहत Magistrate protection, residence, monetary, custody, compensation तथा interim या ex parte orders पर विचार कर सकते हैं (धारा 18–23)। यह अधिनियम की सामान्य जानकारी है; कोई आदेश अपने-आप नहीं मिलता और लागू होना तथ्यों तथा सक्षम प्राधिकारी पर निर्भर करता है।
content.hinglish: India Code ke Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 mein shared household mein rehne ka right (Section 17) aur woh provisions hain jinke tahat Magistrate protection, residence, monetary, custody, compensation, aur interim ya ex parte orders consider kar sakte hain (Sections 18–23). Yeh Act ki general information hai; koi order automatic nahi hota, aur application facts aur competent authority par depend karti hai.

source_name: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice

title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023: stalking and sexual-harassment provisions
summary: India Code's Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita includes section 78 on stalking and section 75 on sexual harassment. Section 78 describes specific conduct and exceptions. Whether the law applies to an incident depends on the full text and facts; this is not a legal finding.

content.en: India Code's Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 contains section 78 titled Stalking and section 75 titled Sexual harassment. Section 78 describes repeated following/contact despite a clear indication of disinterest and monitoring certain forms of a woman's electronic communication, with exceptions in the provision. This is a pointer to the official statutory text, not a conclusion that a particular situation meets the legal definition.
content.hi: India Code के Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 में धारा 78 का शीर्षक Stalking और धारा 75 का शीर्षक Sexual harassment है। धारा 78 में स्पष्ट अनिच्छा के बाद बार-बार पीछा/संपर्क और महिला के कुछ इलेक्ट्रॉनिक संचार की निगरानी का वर्णन है; उसमें अपवाद भी दिए गए हैं। यह आधिकारिक कानून तक पहुँचने का संकेत है, किसी घटना पर कानूनी निष्कर्ष नहीं।
content.hinglish: India Code ke Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 mein Section 78 ka title Stalking aur Section 75 ka title Sexual harassment hai. Section 78 clear disinterest ke baad repeated following/contact aur woman ke kuch electronic communication ki monitoring describe karta hai; provision mein exceptions bhi hain. Yeh official law ka pointer hai, kisi incident par legal conclusion nahi.

source_name: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice

title: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013
summary: India Code's Act includes provisions for prevention, Internal and Local Committees, complaints and inquiry. Which committee or process applies depends on the workplace and circumstances; consult the official Act and a qualified advisor.

content.en: India Code's Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 includes provisions on prevention (section 3), Internal Committees (section 4), Local Committees (sections 5–8), complaints (section 9), conciliation (section 10), and inquiry (section 11). The available route depends on the workplace and facts. This summary is not an assessment of an individual case.
content.hi: India Code के Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013 में रोकथाम (धारा 3), Internal Committee (धारा 4), Local Committee (धारा 5–8), शिकायत (धारा 9), conciliation (धारा 10) और inquiry (धारा 11) के प्रावधान हैं। कौन-सा रास्ता लागू होता है, यह कार्यस्थल और तथ्यों पर निर्भर करता है। यह किसी व्यक्तिगत मामले का कानूनी आकलन नहीं है।
content.hinglish: India Code ke Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013 mein prevention (Section 3), Internal Committee (Section 4), Local Committee (Sections 5–8), complaint (Section 9), conciliation (Section 10), aur inquiry (Section 11) ke provisions hain. Kaunsa route apply hota hai, yeh workplace aur facts par depend karta hai. Yeh kisi individual case ka legal assessment nahi hai.

source_name: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice

title: Free legal services for women
summary: NALSA's official FAQ states that women are eligible to apply for free legal aid under section 12(c) of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987. Contact the relevant Legal Services Authority to learn how to apply and what services are available.

content.en: The National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) FAQ states that a woman is eligible to apply for free legal aid under section 12(c) of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987. Contact the appropriate Legal Services Authority for current application steps and to understand available assistance. This is general information, not advice about a particular case.
content.hi: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) के FAQ के अनुसार, Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 की धारा 12(c) के तहत महिला मुफ्त कानूनी सहायता के लिए आवेदन करने की पात्र है। आवेदन के मौजूदा तरीके और उपलब्ध सहायता जानने के लिए संबंधित Legal Services Authority से संपर्क करें। यह किसी खास मामले की कानूनी सलाह नहीं है।
content.hinglish: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) ke FAQ ke mutabik, Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 ke Section 12(c) ke under women free legal aid ke liye apply karne ki eligible hain. Apply karne ke current steps aur available support ke liye apni relevant Legal Services Authority se contact karein. Yeh individual case ki legal advice nahi hai.

source_name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA), Government of India

title: Women Helpline (181) and support services
summary: The Ministry of Women and Child Development describes Women Helpline 181 as a toll-free, 24-hour service connecting callers to emergency response and One Stop Centres. Its page notes availability may vary by State/UT; check local operation. It is an official support line, not SafeHer AI.

content.en: The Ministry of Women and Child Development describes Women Helpline 181 as a toll-free, 24-hour service for women seeking support or information. It can connect callers with emergency response services and One Stop Centres for support including legal aid and psychosocial counselling. The Ministry notes State/UT availability can vary; check whether it is operational where you are. SafeHer AI does not call the helpline for you.
content.hi: महिला एवं बाल विकास मंत्रालय के अनुसार Women Helpline 181 महिलाओं के लिए टोल-फ्री, 24 घंटे की सहायता और जानकारी सेवा है। यह emergency response services और One Stop Centres से जोड़ सकती है; इनमें कानूनी सहायता और मनोसामाजिक परामर्श शामिल हो सकते हैं। मंत्रालय के पेज के अनुसार State/UT में उपलब्धता अलग हो सकती है—अपने क्षेत्र में इसकी उपलब्धता जाँचें। SafeHer AI आपकी ओर से कॉल नहीं करता।
content.hinglish: Ministry of Women and Child Development ke mutabik Women Helpline 181 women ke liye toll-free, 24-hour support aur information service hai. Yeh emergency response services aur One Stop Centres se connect kar sakti hai; support mein legal aid aur psychosocial counselling ho sakti hai. State/UT availability vary kar sakti hai, isliye apne area mein check karein. SafeHer AI aapki taraf se call nahi karta.

source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India

title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs portal accepts online cybercrime reports and provides a women/children-related reporting path. Its official instructions say to contact local police in an emergency or for non-cyber crimes; reporting is handled by law-enforcement agencies.

content.en: The Ministry of Home Affairs' National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal provides online reporting paths for cybercrime, including a women/children-related path. The portal says complaints are handled by law-enforcement agencies and asks reporters to provide accurate information. Its instructions direct people to local police for emergencies or crimes other than cybercrime. Use the portal's own categories and instructions; this does not guarantee an outcome.
content.hi: गृह मंत्रालय का National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal साइबर अपराध की ऑनलाइन रिपोर्टिंग की सुविधा देता है, जिसमें महिलाओं/बच्चों से संबंधित रिपोर्टिंग का विकल्प भी है। पोर्टल के अनुसार शिकायतें कानून-प्रवर्तन एजेंसियों को भेजी जाती हैं और सही जानकारी देनी चाहिए। आपातकाल या गैर-साइबर अपराध के लिए पोर्टल स्थानीय पुलिस से संपर्क करने को कहता है। पोर्टल के मौजूदा विकल्प और निर्देश देखें; कार्रवाई का परिणाम निश्चित नहीं है।
content.hinglish: Ministry of Home Affairs ka National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal cybercrime ki online reporting deta hai, jisme women/children-related report ka option bhi hai. Portal kehta hai complaints law-enforcement agencies handle karti hain aur sahi details deni chahiye. Emergency ya non-cyber crime ke liye local police contact karne ko kehta hai. Portal ke current categories/instructions follow karein; outcome guaranteed nahi hai.

source_name: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

title: SHe-Box workplace sexual-harassment complaint portal
summary: The Ministry of Women and Child Development links to SHe-Box for workplace sexual-harassment complaints. Review the portal's current scope, privacy terms and instructions before submitting anything; SafeHer AI does not submit complaints.

content.en: The Ministry of Women and Child Development links to the SHe-Box portal for workplace-related sexual-harassment complaints. Before using it, read the portal's current scope, privacy information, eligibility and submission instructions. SafeHer AI cannot file or track a complaint for you and does not determine whether a particular law applies.
content.hi: महिला एवं बाल विकास मंत्रालय workplace sexual harassment शिकायतों के लिए SHe-Box पोर्टल का लिंक देता है। इस्तेमाल से पहले पोर्टल का मौजूदा दायरा, गोपनीयता जानकारी, पात्रता और जमा करने के निर्देश पढ़ें। SafeHer AI आपकी शिकायत दर्ज या ट्रैक नहीं कर सकता और यह तय नहीं करता कि कोई कानून आपके मामले पर लागू होता है या नहीं।
content.hinglish: Ministry of Women and Child Development workplace sexual harassment complaints ke liye SHe-Box portal link karta hai. Use karne se pehle portal ka current scope, privacy details, eligibility aur submission instructions padhein. SafeHer AI aapki complaint file/track nahi karta aur yeh decide nahi karta ki koi law aapke case par apply hota hai ya nahi.
